_comment: The Last City's townsfolk. Same pipeline as the bestiary, different needs:
MOST NPCs NEED ONLY A WALK. An innkeeper does not fight, so demanding an attack of
one would leave every shopkeeper permanently unfinished and re-queued every run. An
entry declares its own needs by carrying an `attack` description or not.
Each is an ANCESTRY crossed with a ROLE, and the roles are the city's real ones -
the districts in `city.rs` and the orders in docs/lore/factions.md - so the crowd
explains the town instead of decorating it. Ancestry spread is deliberate: humans,
halflings, elves, dwarves, hare-folk, hobgoblins and gnomes, at different heights and
builds, because a crowd of one silhouette reads as a copy-paste however good each one is.
They replace three Kenney GRAVEYARD models - a keeper, a ghost and a skeleton - that
have been standing in the friendly hub as 'a hint of the crowd to come'.
style: in a weird HD-2D fantasy style

variants.npc_apothecary_keeper: a slight elderly gnome apothecary with round green spectacles and a shock of white hair, in a stained herbalist's smock, carrying a rack of glass vials
variants.npc_broker: a sharp-eyed halfling broker in a fine embroidered waistcoat and half-moon glasses, a ledger under one arm and a coin purse at the belt
variants.npc_master_smith: a broad dwarf master smith with a forked iron-grey beard bound in rings, soot-black leather apron over heavy arms, a hammer through the belt
variants.npc_alembic_keeper: a tall willowy elf alchemist in layered pale-green robes with long braided hair, holding a softly glowing retort of blue liquid
variants.npc_innkeeper: a round cheerful halfling innkeeper in a rolled-sleeve shirt and long apron, a towel over one shoulder and a tankard in hand
variants.npc_quartermaster: a stern hobgoblin quartermaster with grey-green skin and a scarred jaw, in a Wall Defense tabard, holding a requisition slate
variants.npc_vault_clerk: a fastidious gnome vault clerk in a high-collared coat with brass buttons, a ring of heavy keys and a lantern
variants.npc_bounty_clerk: a lean hare-folk bounty clerk with long grey-brown ears and dark eyes, in a travelling coat, pinning a notice to a board
variants.npc_townsfolk_human: a middle-aged human townswoman in a plain belted dress and headscarf, carrying a covered basket
variants.npc_townsfolk_halfling: a stout halfling townsman in patched breeches and a knitted jerkin, barefoot, carrying a sack over one shoulder
variants.npc_townsfolk_elf: a slender elf townsman in a simple grey-green tunic with long pale hair tied back, carrying a bundle of scrolls
variants.npc_townsfolk_dwarf: a squat dwarf townswoman with a coiled red braid and heavy boots, carrying a stack of firewood
variants.npc_townsfolk_harefolk: a tall lean hare-folk townsman with long upright ears and soft brown fur, in a woven tunic, carrying a bundle of greens
variants.npc_townsfolk_hobgoblin: a burly hobgoblin townswoman with grey-green skin and tied-back black hair, in a leather working smock, carrying a crate
variants.npc_townsfolk_gnome: a tiny gnome townsman with an enormous white moustache and a floppy cap, carrying a toolbox nearly as big as he is
variants.npc_child: a small human child in an oversized patched tunic, barefoot, clutching a carved wooden toy
variants.npc_beggar: a gaunt stooped human in a threadbare hooded cloak, leaning on a stick, one hand out
variants.npc_cartographer: a weathered human cartographer of the Explorers in a long teal coat, a rolled map case at the hip and a brass compass in hand

creatures.walk: walking forward at an unhurried pace
marching forward at a steady patrol pace
creatures.attack: stepping into a forward strike with its weapon

variants.npc_soldier_sword: a human Wall Defense soldier in ivory-and-steel plate with a violet sash, a straight sword in one hand and a kite shield on the other arm
variants.npc_soldier_bow: a lean elf Wall Defense archer in light ivory scale over a violet gambeson, drawing a tall recurve bow, a quiver at the hip
variants.npc_soldier_spear: a dwarf Wall Defense spearman in heavy ivory-and-steel plate, gripping a long spear upright, a round shield slung at the back
variants.npc_soldier_captain: a scarred hobgoblin Wall Defense captain in ornate ivory plate with a violet half-cape and a plumed helm under one arm, hand on a sheathed blade
variants.npc_phoenix_guard_sentry: a Phoenix Guard sentry in heavy silvered plate chased with flame motifs, a tabard of deep red, holding a two-handed silvered sword point-down
